ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 15% high-intensity pixels (white) localized at the distal tips against a 85% low-intensity (black) central and medial surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity geometric blobs; left lobe distal tip contains a large white patch with irregular interior boundaries and dark vertical inclusions; right lobe distal tip contains a smaller white patch with a sharp jagged proximal edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 8% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency undulations across the medial trailing edge; transition to high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks (serrations) on the distal-most 5% of both lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-phasic curve with proximal convexity transitioning to distal concavity near the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast nodes (white) and dark indentations concentrated on the extreme distal edges and tips of both lobes, indicating clustered barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct near-vertical dark linear streaks localized within the high-intensity white patch on the left distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular calcified-looking protrusions on the terminal edges of both fluke tips, causing deviation from a smooth geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion in the lower-central region caused by vertical water spray and droplets, masking surface detail near the peduncle junction.
